summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 104,462.348 shares of Class I common stock for $1,995,000 in total consideration, completed under subscription agreements with accredited investors or non-U.S. persons. The shares were sold as of August 3, 2026, with the number finalized on August 21, 2026, per Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D or S. The 8-K also provides a preliminary NAV per share of $19.10 as of July 31, 2026, with total investments of $2.2 billion and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.96x. This is a routine capital raise and periodic NAV disclosure by an externally managed business development company, not a special situation. No change of control, strategic transaction, or unusual event is present — the issuer simply sold shares at a modest premium to NAV ($19.10). The 'what to watch' would be continued fund flows and NAV trend, but no risk-arb angle applies.
